qualitative.observations: Predeclared visual review of I-1-1 and I-2-1 showed the C0, M06, and F15 views retained the same gross anatomy and hard foreground/background separation. F15 showed modestly stronger local contrast in faint peripheral/ear and weak rib/vertebral structures, with no qualitative basis here for a clinical or production conclusion; M06 and F15 remained visually close and clipping differences were not decisive in the reviewed representatives.
qualitative.selection_rule: Before candidate inspection, use the original predeclared qualitative representatives: the first two mapped logical identities in each anatomy under the established identity ordering, I-1-1 and I-2-1; inspect faint peripheral/ear and hard separation for Kepala, and weak vertebral/rib/local structure and clipping/hard separation for Tulang Belakang.
